subject: Error in rbind(S, data) :    number of columns of matrices must match (see arg 2)

messages.author: 914550a7f90bd757
messages.subject: Error in rbind(S, data) :    number of columns of matrices must match (see arg 2)
parts:
Hi,

I am PhD student currently analysing some of my Actilife RAW data files collected using the GT9X actigraphs. 

I have come across an error when trying to analyse my CSV files on GGIR:

Error in rbind(S, data) : number of columns of matrices must match (see arg 2)

It is strange as some files are still analysing (ones of smaller size) but the majority are not. I have checked this group and saw that a fix was posted for this issue however it does not appear to be working for me if I am implementing it correctly.

I just wondered if anyone else has had problems with this issue or if anyone would be kind enough to direct me on how to fix it.

Many thanks,
Dan

My script:
 
library(GGIR)
g.shell.GGIR(
  mode=c(1),
  datadir="removed for personal info",
  outputdir="removed for personal info ",
  do.report=c(2),
  do.parallel=FALSE,
  f0 = 1,
  f1 = 9,
  overwrite=TRUE,
  #=====================
  # Part 2
  #=====================
  strategy = 1,
  ndayswindow=7,
  hrs.del.start = 1,
  hrs.del.end = 1,
  maxdur = 18,
  includedaycrit = 10,
  L5M5window = c(0,24),
  M5L5res = 10,
  winhr = c(5,10),
  qlevels = c(c(1380/1440),c(1410/1440)),
  qwindow=c(0,24),
  ilevels = c(0,45,101,429,8000),
  iglevels = TRUE,
  mvpathreshold =c(45, 101, 429),
  boutcriter = c(0.8),            mvpadur = c(1,5,10),
  bout.metric = 4,
  #=====================
  # Part 3 + 4
  #=====================
  def.noc.sleep = 1,
  outliers.only = TRUE,
  criterror = 4,
  do.visual = TRUE,
  #=====================
  # Part 5
  #=====================
  threshold.lig = c(30), threshold.mod = c(100),  threshold.vig = c(400),
        boutcriter.in = 0.9,     boutcriter.lig = 0.8,
  boutcriter.mvpa = 0.8, boutdur.in = c(1,10,30), boutdur.lig = c(1,10),
  boutdur.mvpa = c(1),
  includedaycrit.part5 = 2/3,
  #=====================
  # Visual report
  #=====================
  timewindow = c("WW"),
  visualreport=TRUE)

messages.author: c2b608cf1a4e77a3
messages.subject: Re: Error in rbind(S, data) : number of columns of matrices must match (see arg 2)
parts:
Hi Daniel,

I had this issue using the latest CRAN version of GGIR (2.9-0). Have you tried processing your data using the newest version of GGIR in Git Hub (2.9-5)? This worked for me.

Try: 
library(devtools)
install_github("wadpac/GG...@2.9-5")

Best,
Marcus

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Error in rbind(S, data) :    number of columns of matrices must match (see arg 2)
parts:
Hi Daniel,

When error message include 'rbind' then that usually indicates that something goes wrong with combining (derived) data. This can happen when some of the files are processed with one GGIR configuration and other files. In that case I would advise reprocessing all data in a new folder with one consistent R script. There may be other explanations but this is the first one I would be test.

If that does not address the issue then maybe try using the new GGIR release(more about that in my email later today).

Best,

Vincent
